bosses.name: Grubbis
bosses.general: Comes at the end of Emi Shortfuse's trogg waves, with his pet Chomper.
bosses.tank: Hold the trogg waves near Emi, then Grubbis and Chomper together.
bosses.healer: Keep Emi alive through the waves as well as the tank.
bosses.dps: Kill the troggs going for Emi; Chomper, then Grubbis.

bosses.name: Viscous Fallout
bosses.general: Radioactive ooze: Toxic Volley poisons everyone near.
bosses.healer: Cure poison and heal the volley.

bosses.name: Electrocutioner 6000
bosses.general: Chain Bolt jumps between players and Shock stuns. Drops the Workshop Key.
bosses.dps: Ranged spread out so the bolt doesn't chain.

bosses.name: Crowd Pummeler 9-60
bosses.general: Crowd Pummel knocks back and stuns everyone in front of it; Arcing Smash cleaves.
bosses.tank: Face it away from the group and put your back to a wall.
bosses.dps: Everyone behind it, never in front.

bosses.name: Dark Iron Ambassador
bosses.general: Rare: Fire Shield and a fire elemental friend.

bosses.name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
bosses.general: Walking Bombs come out of the vents around the room and blow up in the group. Knock Away on the tank.
bosses.tank: Back to a wall so Knock Away doesn't throw you; get back fast.
bosses.healer: Heal the bomb blasts, stay away from the vents.
bosses.dps: Kill the bombs before they reach us (or press the vent buttons), then back on him.
